scope: Activate canonical navigation and preserve the existing guide fragments. The subsequent guide, architecture, evidence and contribution tasks apply the proposed dispositions; this plan does not claim those migrations or the prose rewrite are complete.

actions.keep: Retain the document or canonical URL; later editing may shorten or clarify it.
actions.merge: Move useful content into the listed destinations before retiring the source.
actions.move: Preserve content at the listed internal destination; a short overview may reuse the source path.
actions.delete: Remove only a proven duplicate after its replacement and inbound links are verified. No baseline document is deleted by this structure change.

inventory_rule: Every tracked Markdown file, every file under docs/, LICENSE, NOTICE, and contribution issue templates at the baseline commit; new structure contracts are mapped too.
routing: Each retired guide path redirects to its preserved source section. Internal links to active source fragments keep exact heading targets. Cloudflare cannot inspect an incoming URL fragment, so an external deep link on a retired path lands at the source section. Legacy route anchors stay explicit when later prose is consolidated.
